prompt: What was the official retail price per liter (in VND, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax) of RON 92-III gasoline on April 24, 2025, according to PetroVietnam Oil Corporation (PVOIL)?
answer: According to PVOIL, the retail price was **VND 19,230 per liter** at 15:00 on April 24, 2025, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax. PVOIL listed the product as **E5 RON 92-II** (the RON 92 gasoline grade).
